metadata.title: Data Density Pass 14 -- Reserve Positions Both Armies
metadata.description: Reserve unit positions across all three days. VI Corps (Sedgwick) arriving July 2, Union artillery reserve, Confederate reserve brigades awaiting commitment, Pickett's division in reserve before the charge. Shows the strategic depth both armies maintained and the agonizing wait of units not yet committed.

placements.notes: VI Corps beginning 35-mile forced march from Manchester -- will not arrive until late July 2
VI Corps leading division approaching -- men exhausted from the march
VI Corps arriving -- too late for Day 2 fighting. 15,000 fresh men in reserve.
Getty's division -- all of VI Corps now in reserve on the Baltimore Pike
Artillery Reserve (Tyler) -- 100 guns in reserve behind Cemetery Hill
Artillery Reserve drawing ammunition -- feeding McGilvery's line
Artillery Reserve overnight -- 77 guns still uncommitted
McLaws's division -- waiting for Longstreet's orders since dawn
Hood's division in reserve -- Law's brigade leading the reconnaissance
Pickett's division -- assigned to guard the supply trains. They will not fight today.
Pickett watching from Seminary Ridge as Longstreet's corps bleeds at the Peach Orchard
Pickett's division overnight -- Longstreet has promised to place them on the right tomorrow
Garnett's brigade in reserve -- the last reserves Lee has
Kemper's brigade in reserve
Armistead's brigade in reserve behind the crest
Johnson's division in reserve -- will assault Culp's Hill tonight
Anderson's division in reserve behind Seminary Ridge
Anderson in reserve while Wright briefly crests Cemetery Ridge
Pender's division in reserve -- Pender mortally wounded by shell fragment today
Crawford's Pennsylvania Reserves -- held back until the crisis at Little Round Top
Willard's brigade in reserve -- Harper's Ferry veterans seeking redemption
